title: Manga Plus Adds Tabireco's Baby Road Trippers Manga
content: Shueisha 's MANGA Plus platform added Tabireco 's Baby Road Trippers ( Baby Shachū Hackers ) manga on Thursday. The manga's first 20 chapters are available immediately. MANGA Plus describes the manga: “I find school kinda stifling.” Fuji Yonagi is a high school girl who struggles to fit in with her class and finds…

title: Kei Sanbe Launches Aria's Adventures in Miracleland Manga
content: Kadokawa 's Comic Newtype digital magazine revealed on Thursday that Kei Sanbe is launching a new manga titled Aria's Adventures in Miracleland ( Kiseki no Shima no Aria ) on Friday. The first chapter is available on the KadoComi website .
author: ANN

title: I'm Dating a Dark Summoner Anime's Teaser Video Reveals More Staff
content: The official website for the short anime of Shaoh 's I'm Dating a Dark Summoner ( Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru ) manga began streaming a teaser trailer for the anime on Friday. The trailer reveals more staff members for the anime.
author: ANN

title: Look Back Gets an Official New Release Ahead of Live-Action Movie Debut
content: Best known for creating acclaimed manga such as Chainsaw Man and Fire Punch , Tatsuki Fujimoto has released several intriguing series and one-shots over his decade-long career. title: 14 Years Later, Naruto’s Final War Confirms a New Physical Release in August
content: Even several years after its ending, Masashi Kishimoto’s beloved Weekly Shonen Jump series Naruto is still loved among global fans. Thanks to its captivating story, intriguing characters, and thrilling fights, Naruto is easily one of the most acclaimed shows of all time.
author: ComicBook

title: Demon Slayer and Solo Leveling Studios Are Open to Using AI in Anime Production
content: Demon Slayer and Solo Leveling are among the biggest modern anime series, and with those behind them considering the use of AI, it could significantly change the anime industry’s landscape.
author: ComicBook

title: Uma Musume: Pretty Derby Franchise's World Tour Concert Performance Comes to Los Angeles on October 22-23
content: Cygames ' Uma Musume Pretty Derby franchise announced on Thursday that the Uma Musume: Pretty Derby – 7th Event World Tour: The Stage global tour will come to Los Angeles' Peacock Theater on October 22 at 8:00 p.m. PDT and October 23 at 7:00 p.m. PDT.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Solo Leveling Replacement Is Already Succeeding
content: Solo Leveling is undoubtedly one of the most successful anime to have launched on Crunchyroll over the past two years. It has become one of the biggest sensations in the anime industry, and there is no denying that few series will be able to match its impact.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Critically Acclaimed Sci-Fi Series Returns With an Official New Look After Finale
content: Seven years after its premiere, the acclaimed Dr. Stone anime reached its conclusion in June this year. The anime is based on an award-winning manga written by Riichiro Inagaki and illustrated by Boichi, which began serialization in Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 2017.
author: ComicBook

title: Marvel Artist Jumps Into The Shonen Anime World For San Diego Comic Con
content: Marvel Comics took a blow earlier this year when it announced that it would be ending its partnership with Shueisha. In recent years, Marvel has teamed up with Shonen Jump to create several new manga series that took characters like Deadpool and Spider-Man, giving them a brand-new aesthetic.
author: ComicBook
